narrativeVibe: Present-day realism with a layer of mystery — grounded, tense and character-driven.
scenario: Modern life hides stranger things beneath the surface. You've stumbled onto a conspiracy ordinary people are never supposed to notice, and it's not letting you go.
start: A late-night call drags you across the city: an old friend has vanished, leaving behind a cryptic message. The police won't help. {{user}}, what do you do?
imageStyleTags: (masterpiece:1.2), cinematic, photorealistic, photography, urban realism, natural light, high detail
imageNegativeTags: low quality, fused digits, bad anatomy, watermark, text

defs.label: Social
defs.hint: Conversation and connections — talking, persuading, making friends
defs.rules: Conversation, persuasion and networking. Used to talk your way into (or out of) things, win people over, read a room and build relationships.

defs.label: Fitness
defs.rules: Physical conditioning. Used for strength, stamina and athletic effort — running, lifting, sports, fighting, hiking and staying healthy.

defs.label: Intellect
defs.hint: Knowledge and logic — learning, analysis, problem-solving
defs.rules: Learning, memory and analytical thinking. Used to study, reason through problems, pick up new subjects quickly and connect the dots.

defs.label: Handy
defs.hint: Practical skills — fixing, building, repairs, DIY
defs.rules: Practical, hands-on skill. Used to fix, build and maintain things around the home and on the go — plumbing, wiring, assembly, small repairs and improvisation with everyday tools.

defs.label: Creativity
defs.hint: Creative expression — art, writing, cooking, improvisation
defs.rules: Creative expression. Used for art, writing, music, cooking, design and thinking up original ideas or clever improvisations on the spot.

defs.label: Insight
defs.hint: Reading people and situations — empathy, intuition
defs.rules: Empathy and intuition. Used to read moods and intentions, tell when someone is lying or hurting, and understand what a situation really needs.

defs.label: Street Smarts
defs.hint: Everyday savvy — navigating the city, finding things, blending in
defs.rules: Everyday savvy. Used to navigate the city, find the right people or places, blend into a crowd, haggle and survive day-to-day urban life.

defs.label: Tech
defs.hint: Digital fluency — devices, apps, computers, online life
defs.rules: Comfort and skill with modern technology. Used for phones, computers, apps, settings, online research, social media and troubleshooting devices.

trackers.label: Day Name
trackers.rules: The current day of the week — Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday or Sunday. Advance to the next weekday whenever a full day passes in the story.

trackers.label: Time
trackers.rules: The current time of day — Morning, Afternoon, Evening or Night. Advance as the story's hours pass; roughly one step per few hours of in-game time.
Where the hero currently is — neighborhood, building or landmark. Short and specific, e.g. "Downtown — police precinct", "Riverside, apartment 4B". Update whenever the scene moves.

trackers.label: Lvl
trackers.rules: The hero's level. Grant a level-up when exp is full.

trackers.label: Exp
trackers.rules: Experience toward the next level. Award exp for solving problems and breakthroughs. When exp fills to its max of 100 the hero levels up and exp resets to 0.

trackers.label: Cash
trackers.rules: The hero's money. Track purchases, paychecks and payments here.

trackers.label: Stamina
trackers.rules: Physical energy for exertion — running, fighting, long days. Spent by heavy effort, restored by rest. Max derives from Fitness.
